methodology.selection: Each market/horizon/side selects on trailing training data; metrics aggregate only following OOS folds.
methodology.geographicHoldout: A second validation freezes each model using US results only, then evaluates that exact model on every other market.

earningsRevisionFactor.reason: No point-in-time analyst-estimate history or authenticated provider is available. Current estimates would create look-ahead bias.

limitations: Current static constituents create survivorship bias and exclude delisted names.
Sector classification is current/static; price bars are historical and date-aligned.
Fixed-notional trade sums do not enforce a shared overlapping-position capital limit.
